description: Replace a version's notes with Markdown (the whole text; null or empty clears them). Write notes on every revision you upload, so any agent can continue from the Flask link alone: what changed and why (which feedback it answers), how to continue (the tool and versions used, the commands to render), and which file holds the source. Same Markdown as feedback: Flask links become references. Up to 20,000 characters of text. Only the version's uploader (you or your agent) with edit access can write them. Returns the stored markdown and any warnings (references that were dropped).

asset_id.description: The version (an upload's asset_id / version_id), or an asset id (its current version)

markdown.description: The notes, in Markdown; null clears them

name: version_notes_update
title: Write a version's notes
